content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder selling new homes and title, mortgage and insurance services; no lease-to-own or merchandise rental business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder selling new homes with mortgage lending and build-to-rent housing; differs from lease-to-own merchandise retail."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder selling single-family homes and townhomes with mortgage and title services; no rent-to-own merchandise."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Pawn lending and used merchandise resale to cash-needing shoppers; no lease-to-own payment plans on new goods."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Casual seafood restaurants, liquor stores and franchising; entirely different food and beverage business."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Supermarkets, pharmacy and fuel centers with shopping center leasing; grocery retail, not lease-to-own."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder with mortgage, title and insurance services for homebuyers; no lease-to-own or rent-to-own business."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"AI lending platform funding auto and personal loans for banks and investors; B2B credit network, not lease-to-own retail."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Provides lease-to-own payment plans for furniture, electronics and appliances through retail and online merchant partners, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases logistics warehouses to businesses; real estate landlord with no consumer merchandise leasing."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Supermarkets with pharmacy and fuel selling groceries to households; grocery retail, not lease-to-own."}]}
